He holds the mind firmly. He makes perfect aspirational prayers. He generates faith so that virtuous qualities that have already arisen may remain, not decline, increase extensively, grow even further, and so that they may be cultivated and brought to perfection. He exerts himself. He initiates diligence. He holds the mind firmly. He makes perfect aspirational prayers.

He fully cultivates the <term>riddhipada</term> <gloss>base of miraculous power</gloss> of intention, which is endowed with the formative activity of abandoning and concentration, based on seclusion, based on detachment, based on cessation, and perfected through total relinquishment.

He fully cultivates the base of miraculous power of diligence, which is endowed with the formative activity of abandoning and concentration, based on seclusion, based on detachment, based on cessation, and perfected through total relinquishment.

He fully cultivates the base of miraculous power of the mind, which is endowed with the formative activity of abandoning and concentration, based on seclusion, based on detachment, based on cessation, and perfected through total relinquishment.

He fully cultivates the base of miraculous power of investigation, which is endowed with the formative activity of abandoning and concentration, based on seclusion, based on detachment, based on cessation, and perfected through total relinquishment.

He fully cultivates the <term>bala</term> <gloss>power</gloss> of mindfulness, based on seclusion, based on detachment, based on cessation, and perfected through total relinquishment.

He fully cultivates the power of concentration, based on seclusion, based on detachment, based on cessation, and perfected through total relinquishment.

He fully cultivates the power of wisdom, based on seclusion, based on detachment, based on cessation, and perfected through total relinquishment.

He fully cultivates the <term>bodhyanga</term> <gloss>limb of enlightenment</gloss> of correct mindfulness, based on seclusion, based on detachment, based on cessation, and perfected through total relinquishment.

He fully cultivates the limb of enlightenment of the investigation of phenomena, based on seclusion, based on detachment, based on cessation, and perfected through total relinquishment.

He fully cultivates the limb of enlightenment of diligence, based on seclusion, based on detachment, based on cessation, and perfected through total relinquishment.

<summary>This page details the cultivation of the thirty-seven factors of enlightenment, specifically focusing on the four right exertions, the four bases of miraculous power, the five powers, and the limbs of awakening. Each practice is described as being grounded in seclusion, detachment, and cessation.</summary>
